initialAnnouncementsData.title: Midterm examination schedule has been posted.
initialAnnouncementsData.author: Dr. Sarah Mitchell
initialAnnouncementsData.content: The midterm examination will take place on Wednesday, October 14, from 10:00 AM to 11:30 AM in Science Building 204. The exam covers query optimization, B+ trees, concurrency control, and two-phase locking. You may bring one double-sided 8.5x11 inch handwritten cheat sheet. Review session details will be sent next Monday.

initialAnnouncementsData.title: Project submission rubric has been updated.
initialAnnouncementsData.author: Prof. Daniel Carter
initialAnnouncementsData.content: Please review the revised grading rubric for Sprint 2 deliverables uploaded under the Syllabus & Course Resources module. We have added specific evaluation criteria for CI/CD test coverage (minimum 80% branch coverage required) and Docker containerization benchmarks.

initialAnnouncementsData.title: Next week's lab session will be held in Lab 3.
initialAnnouncementsData.author: Dr. Emily Watson
initialAnnouncementsData.content: Due to scheduled network maintenance in Engineering 115, our scheduled hands-on session next Wednesday will take place in Computing Lab 3 (Engineering 220). Ensure your Docker runtime is updated to version 27.x before arriving so you can run the multi-node Raft testbed.
